chunks: ʿAlī, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام: concerning
A man upon whom there are prescribed punishments, among them killing. He said: “The prescribed punishments are carried out upon him, then he is killed.”

key_terms.يُقْتَلُ: is killed after the other punishments
key_terms.ٱلرَّجُلِ: the man who is subject to the ruling
key_terms.ٱلْقَتْلُ: execution or killing as one of the punishments

ai.seo_question: If a man is liable for multiple hudud punishments including execution, in what order are they carried out?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a man liable for multiple prescribed punishments, including execution. It states that the other hudud punishments are first carried out on him, and then he is put to death.
